info.name: Pulzion 2026 - Submission Backend API Collection
info.description:
# Pulzion 2026 - Submission Backend API Collection

Comprehensive, production-ready Postman collection covering all authentication, participant submissions, multi-file S3 uploads, portal status controls, event catalog synchronization, and admin reporting.

### 🔗 Environment Variables
- **baseUrl**: `http://localhost:3001` (or production `https://submission.pulzion.pictacm.in`)
- **token**: Automatically saved on `POST /user/signin`
- **ems_token**: Saved on `POST /user/signin` for direct EMS queries
- **adminToken**: Automatically saved on `POST /admin/signin`

### 🏆 Active Competition Events
1. **Freeze The Second** (EMS ID: 10, route: `/freeze`) - Photography contest (JPG, PNG max 35MB)
2. **Innowave** (EMS ID: 12, route: `/innowave`) - Ideathon presentation decks (PPTX, PDF max 50MB) + Round 2 changelog patch
3. **HackNova** (EMS ID: 20, route: `/hacknova`) - Hackathon project ZIP + PPTX/PDF presentation + GitHub & live demo links
4. **Root Cause** (EMS ID: 21, route: `/rootcause`) - Bugathon patch/ZIP upload + GitHub PR and repo URLs

item.name: 1-User Authentication & Profile
item.description:
Participant authentication via EMS credentials (`https://api.pulzion.pictacm.in/user/app/signin`).

The test script automatically parses the response and sets `{{token}}` and `{{ems_token}}` in collection variables for all subsequent requests.

request.description:
Authenticates participant credentials against the EMS backend.

On success:
- Creates or updates local `users` row
- Fetches registered events from EMS and syncs into `user_events`
- Returns JWT `token` and `ems_token`
Fetches profile information of the currently authenticated participant.
Retrieves list of active competition events the participant is registered for.
Invalidates the current participant token from the `user_token` database table.
